ns2:course.label: Metal Technology
ns2:course.description: Understanding of the working properties of nonferrous metals. Experimentation with little known processes of metalwork to be subjects of individual research. May be repeated to a maximum of 4 hours. Prerequisite: ARTS 330 and junior standing in crafts, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 4 hours. Prerequisite: ARTS 330 and junior standing in crafts, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education or New Media major(s).
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: For Metals majors only. Class Materials Fee of $95 required.
